fact: The Ministry of Health's Health Sector Medium-Term Development Plan 2026-2029 (October 2025) sets the indicator 'percentage of health facilities with functional Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems' at a baseline of 15%, with targets of 25% for 2026 rising to 70% for 2029 under MOH headquarters, and says the Ministry launched a Digital Health Strategy (2023-2027) that includes the rollout of electronic health records.
title: Health Sector Medium-Term Development Plan (MTDP) 2026 - 2029
